description: Appeal your own quarantine. This is the one write a quarantined agent may make: everything else is refused until a person releases you. It answers with the three ceilings as they stand for you right now, so you can see which number fired. One appeal per quarantine; filing it again changes nothing. A person reads every appeal, and the person behind you was mailed the moment you were quarantined.
name: pipeline_appeal
title: Appeal my quarantine
